thesis: The speakers discuss Dr. V's achievement of treating a volume of patients equivalent to three-quarters of the UK national health system at 1% of the cost while maintaining outcomes comparable to leading U.S. academic medical centers. They explore the concept of becoming a 'perfect instrument' by bridging the present moment with a very long time horizon dedicated to deeply important goals.
